description: This file defines an abstract class `WebOrDesktopDevice` which implements the `WebOrDesktopDeviceInterface`. It provides methods for managing databases, storage, keychain, and device operations for web or desktop environments within the application. The class manages internal database instances, localStorage interactions, URL opening, and abstract methods for keychain operations and device destruction detection, serving as a base for platform-specific subclasses.

classes.name: WebOrDesktopDevice
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for web or desktop devices, including database and local storage management, keychain handling, and device reset operations.

methods.name: setApplication
methods.description: Associates an application instance with the device by creating and storing a new database instance.

methods.name: getJsonParsedRawStorageValue
methods.description: Retrieves a raw storage value by key and parses it as JSON if possible.

methods.name: databaseForIdentifier
methods.description: Finds and returns a database instance matching the provided application identifier.

methods.name: clearAllDataFromDevice
methods.description: Clears all local storage and database entries related to specified workspace identifiers.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the device by deinitializing all associated databases and clearing internal references.

methods.name: getRawStorageValue
methods.description: Retrieves a raw string value from local storage by key.

methods.name: setRawStorageValue
methods.description: Sets a raw string value in local storage with a given key.

methods.name: removeRawStorageValue
methods.description: Removes a raw storage value by key.

methods.name: removeAllRawStorageValues
methods.description: Clears all local storage data.

methods.name: openDatabase
methods.description: Opens a database for a given application identifier, returning a promise that resolves whether the database is new.

methods.name: getDatabaseLoadChunks
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts database entries into chunks based on provided options, for optimized loading.

methods.name: getAllDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Retrieves all payloads from the database associated with the given identifier.

methods.name: getDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Fetches specific payloads for given keys from a database.

methods.name: saveDatabaseEntry
methods.description: Saves a single payload into the database.

methods.name: saveDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Saves multiple payloads into the database.

methods.name: removeDatabaseEntry
methods.description: Removes a payload by ID from the database.

methods.name: removeAllDatabaseEntries
methods.description: Clears all payloads from the database for a given identifier.

methods.name: getNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Retrieves a namespaced keychain value for an application identifier.

methods.name: setNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Sets a namespaced keychain value for an application identifier.

methods.name: clearNamespacedKeychainValue
methods.description: Deletes a namespaced keychain value for an application identifier.

methods.name: setRawKeychainValue
methods.description: Sets a raw keychain value.

methods.name: openUrl
methods.description: Opens a URL in a new browser tab/window.

methods.name: getKeychainValue
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve keychain data; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: setKeychainValue
methods.description: Abstract method to set keychain data; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: clearRawKeychainValue
methods.description: Abstract method to clear keychain data; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: isDeviceDestroyed
methods.description: Abstract method to check if the device has been destroyed; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: performHardReset
methods.description: Abstract method to perform a hard reset of the device; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: performSoftReset
methods.description: Reloads the window to perform a soft reset of the device.
